h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Jehanabad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Jehanabad

items.pText: Jehanabad is a district town in south Bihar, between Patna and Gaya, surrounded by farmland. Its schools, panchayats and community grounds often have open land with no boundary at all. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,400 km away, and sends it to Bihar by road.

On an open ground, the play area has to be protected from more than the weather. Stray cattle wander in, motorcycles cut across, and the equipment may be used at night by people other than children. A simple fence with a gate turns the play area into a defined space that is easier to keep clean and safe. We plan the fence line on the layout drawing, outside every safe play area, so it never sits in the path of a swing or slide.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Fencing and boundaries for an open site

c: Leave a clear gap between the fence and the outer edge of each safe play area. Use one gate, placed away from the road, and keep it latched so small children cannot run out. A low wall or fence also keeps animals off the rubber flooring, which hooves can damage. Inside the boundary, a bench or two lets parents sit and keep watch. Bihar's summers are very hot, so plant a line of trees along the fence for shade in the years ahead.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,400 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Should a playground on open land be fenced?
items.a: Yes, where possible. A fence with one latched gate keeps out animals and vehicles and defines the play area. We plan the fence line outside every safe play area on the layout.

items.q: Do you supply the fencing as well?
items.a: Our range covers play equipment, outdoor gym equipment, garden decor and rubber flooring. Fencing is usually built locally, and we give your contractor the layout so it goes in the right place.

items.q: Can a panchayat or government school in Jehanabad order from you?
items.a: Yes. Share the site size, photos and age group. We send a layout drawing and itemised quote for approval, then manufacture at Vasai and install through our team or a dealer.
